name: 38063 · Ripley, TN
findings: ZIP 38063 (Ripley) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38063 (Ripley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
